risk_note: RV2 (invite reward void decision input). FU-INVITE-REWARD-ORDER-PLATFORM (D10-854 ② / D10-868 ①): B1-08zi made growth's invite-reward void check platform-aware (only platform jd is gated by orders.jd.refunded_quantity_r9_enabled, default off), but the orders fact reader (orders/ports/invite-reward.ts FACT_COLUMNS) did not select o.platform, so a JD order looked non-JD and a returned unit still voided the unpaid reward with the switch off. The reader now selects o.platform and passes it through; growth is untouched. platform stays optional in the port type (same as growth's InviteRewardOrder) so no out-of-paths test fixture changes; [AC-B1-08zj#4] pins that the production reader returns it. No production impact today (JD settlement import not built, invite reward master switch off). Full verification is the required CI checks (approvals 21; AWS runners off, D10-555).
